structure: Fee per card payment = (percentage rate x transaction total) + fixed cents, where the rate depends on plan (Square Free / Square Plus / Square Premium; monthly plan fee is $0 / $49 / $149 per location) and on how the card was taken (in person tap/dip/swipe; online or invoice; online via Square payments APIs; manually entered or card on file). The base is the whole transaction: 'Payment processing fees are taken out of the total amount of each transaction, including tax and tip', and the same rate applies to every card brand. Cards issued outside the US add a 1.5% international surcharge on top of the base rate (not applied to Afterpay, ACH, Cash App Pay, Bitcoin or EBT). ACH bank transfers cost 1% with a $1 minimum, capped at $10 per payment on invoices (Plus/Premium; the Free column shows no cap) and $5 per payment via the API. Fees are deducted before funds are transferred to the seller's bank; no rounding rule is published; chargebacks/dispute management carry no fee.

Processing fees vary based on the Square plan you choose. Square Premium offers the lowest processing fees. If you process over $250,000 per year, you can talk to our team about custom pricing and processing fees.

Square Plus and Square Premium each offer a free 30-day trial, and you can cancel or switch plans anytime. With Square Free, there are no monthly subscription costs — you only pay processing fees when you take a payment.

Payments made with credit or debit cards issued in a different country than the location of your Square account incur a 1.5% international transaction fee, in addition to Square’s base processing fees. International transaction fees apply to in-person, online, card-not-present (CNP), and Square API transactions, as well as all Square pricing tiers.
International transaction fees don’t apply to alternative payment methods such as Afterpay, ACH, Cash App Pay, Bitcoin, or EBT payments.

structure: Standard US pricing: 2.9% of the transaction amount plus $0.30 per successful domestic card transaction (online cards and wallets; same rate for Link, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Cash App Pay). Surcharges add percentage points on the same base: +0.5% for manually entered (Dashboard/MOTO) cards, giving 3.4% + $0.30; +1.5% for cards issued outside the US; +1% if currency conversion is required (surcharges can stack). Stripe does not itemize tax or shipping — the fee applies to the full amount charged. Each Stripe fee is rounded to the nearest cent (0.025 rounds up to 0.03, 0.024 rounds down to 0.02). ACH Direct Debit is 0.8% capped at $5.00 per transaction. Instant Payouts for US accounts cost 1.5% of the payout amount, with each payout between $0.50 and $9,999 and at most 10 per day. Disputes: $15.00 when received plus $15.00 when countered manually (the countered fee is returned if you win). Per the Pricing Policy, each successful refund is charged the fixed fee applicable to the refunded transaction.

Manual-entry pricing is stated two ways that agree: '+0.5% for manually entered cards' on the pricing page and '3.4% + 0.30 USD' on the support article (2.9% + 0.5% = 3.4%). The support article also says only the first subscription payment on a Dashboard-keyed card gets the higher rate.

Refunds: Pricing Policy 1.4 says each successful refund is charged the fixed fee applicable to the refunded transaction (i.e. the $0.30). The hero shows '2.9% + $0.30' and the table shows '2.9% + 30¢' — same rate. The page footer reads 'United States (English)', so these are US rates.
Terminal (in-person) domestic cards are 2.7% + 5¢, plus $0.10 per authorization for Tap to Pay and an optional $0.05 P2PE fee; international cards add 1.5% in person as well.

structure: Two separate fees. (1) Shopify Payments card processing: fee = rate x amount + fixed cents, charged when you capture payment; the rate depends on plan (Basic / Grow / Advanced / Plus) and channel — online standard cards 2.9% / 2.7% / 2.5% (+ 30¢), online premium cards (commercial/corporate/business cards and all domestic Amex) 3.5% / 3.3% / 3.1% (+ 30¢), in-person cards 2.6% / 2.5% / 2.4% (+ 10¢), in-person manual entry 3.5% + 10¢ on every plan; cards issued outside the US add 1% ('cross-border fee'); paying in a non-payout currency adds a 1.5% currency conversion fee (US). The loaded pages do not itemize the base for card fees beyond 'the payment for an order' (i.e. the captured order amount). (2) Third-party transaction fee, charged by Shopify only when a third-party payment provider processes the payment (or on the store-credit/gift-card portion for stores created on or after May 12, 2025): 2% / 1% / 0.6% / 0.2% of [(cost of products - discounts) + tax + shipping charges]; waived entirely when Shopify Payments is the sole provider; if Shopify Payments runs alongside a third-party provider, Shopify Payments transactions also carry a 1.25% premium. Neither card fees nor third-party fees are returned on refunds. No rounding rule is published.

There are no setup fees on any of our plans.
Third-party transaction fees may apply when you use a third-party payment provider (instead of Shopify Payments). The rate depends on your plan.
Shopify charges a small fee to allow you to accept major credit cards, such as Visa and Mastercard, as payment in your store. These fees vary depending on the plan that you choose.

Aside from the credit card rate and the subscription fees for your store's Shopify subscription plan, there are no monthly fees, no hidden fees, and no setup fees for Shopify Payments. When you use Shopify Payments as your sole payment provider, there are no third-party transaction fees for orders.

Transactions processed by your third-party provider, such as credit and debit card payments, are subject to third-party transaction fees based on your Shopify plan.
Transactions processed by Shopify Payments, such as Shop Pay and local payment methods, are charged at standard Shopify Payments rates plus a 1.25% premium. Shopify Payments rates vary by plan type and market.

Standard: Includes domestic consumer cards issued by Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and Diners Club.
Premium: Includes domestic commercial, corporate, or business-tier cards, such as Visa Business, and all domestic American Express cards.
If you process international cards and payment methods, then an additional charge applies above the base rate.

If your online store is based in the United States and you process payments by using Shopify Payments, then you're charged a 1% cross-border fee on all sales made with a credit card issued in another country.
Manually entered payments are subject to higher fees because card details are often collected over the phone or through other unencrypted methods, increasing the risk of fraud.

Shopify uses this formula to calculate third-party transaction fees for a 30-day period:
[(cost of products - discounts) + tax + shipping charges] x rate
The rate for third-party transaction charges varies depending on your pricing plan.

Transaction fees don't apply for POS orders or for manual payment methods, which include cash on delivery (COD), bank deposits, checks, test orders, and draft orders marked as paid or pending. Third-party transaction fees aren't returned to you when you issue an order refund.
Transaction fees are in addition to processing fees charged by your third-party payment provider.

Stores on the Shopify Plus plan that use Shopify Payments as their sole payment provider have their third-party transaction fees waived, including fees on store credit and gift cards. If you use Shopify Payments alongside a third-party payment provider, then transaction fees apply.
Credit card transaction fees aren't returned to you when you issue a refund.
If you switch to an annual billing cycle, then you can receive a discount on your subscription charge. Annual billing charges the full year upfront and presents a lower effective monthly rate.

When you use Shopify Payments, you pay the credit card rate, but you don't pay a transaction fee. Stores that use a third-party payment provider instead of Shopify Payments pay both a transaction fee from Shopify, and credit card fees charged by their third-party payment provider.

When you capture the payment for an order, you're charged a Shopify Payments fee (in your payout currency) which covers the cost of processing the payment. The fee amount depends on the type of credit card that is used and the location where the credit card is registered.
| Currency conversion fee | 1.5% | 2% | 2% |

Currency conversion fee - The fee that Shopify charges (in your payout currency) to convert currencies when you capture a payment. Currency conversion fees and credit card fees are not returned to you when you issue a refund, but you're not charged additional conversion fees when you issue a refund or when you receive a chargeback.

structure: All Venmo fees are a percentage of the payment or transfer amount (some with a fixed cents add-on), deducted from the amount the recipient receives except the credit-card fee, which the sender pays. Sending money funded by a credit card costs the sender 3.00% (waived when paying a business or charity profile); sends funded by balance, debit card or bank are free. Instant Transfer to an eligible debit card or bank costs 1.75% of the transfer amount, minimum $0.25 and maximum $25, deducted from the transfer; standard transfers are free. Receiving a payment the sender tagged as for goods and services on a personal profile costs the seller 2.99% (no fixed part). Business profiles pay 1.9% + $0.10 of the payment total on every payment of $1.00 or more, or 2.29% + $0.09 for Tap to Pay contactless payments; charity profiles pay 1.9% + $0.10. Crypto buys/sells carry a tiered fee by amount (2.20% / 2.00% / 1.80% / 1.50%) plus a spread built into the exchange rate; PYUSD is fee-free. No rounding rule is published.

structure: Personal accounts: sending from the Cash App balance or a debit card is free; sending money funded by a linked credit card costs the sender 3% of the amount (the ToS lists this both as 'Send from credit card 3%' and 'Add money from Credit Card: 3%'); receiving money is free. Standard transfers out to a linked bank/card are free (1–3 business days); Instant Transfer costs 0.5%–2.5% of the amount with a minimum fee of $0.25–$1 and a maximum of $75, with the exact rate only disclosed in-app before confirming. Business accounts: Cash App deducts 2.6% + $0.15 from each payment received from a customer's Cash App account and 3% from each Tap to Pay payment, so the balance credited already nets out the fee. For percentage fees Cash App uses banker's rounding to the penny (numbers ending in 5 round to the nearest even), and fees are deducted first from the collected funds; on a refund Cash App also refunds its fee so the customer gets the full amount back.

notes: Instant Transfer is a published RANGE (0.5%–2.5%, minimum $0.25–$1, maximum $75); the exact percentage is only shown in-app before confirming, so a calculator can only bound the fee (e.g. show the 0.5% and 2.5% cases) or take the rate as an input.

The ToS lists the credit-card charge twice with different labels — 'Send from credit card 3%' (Prepaid Account fee table and P2P section) and 'Add money from Credit Card: 3%' (Details About Your Cash App Balance) — both 3% and both subject to banker's rounding.

Cash App Business 'Tap to Pay' is stated as a flat 3% with no fixed component, versus 2.6% + $0.15 for payments from a customer's Cash App account; no base definition beyond 'each payment you receive' is given (tips/tax not addressed).

Cash App Pay acceptance by merchants is priced by the merchant's processor, not by Cash App: Square's legacy list shows Cash App Pay at 2.6% + 15¢ (card-present) / 3.3% + 30¢ (card-not-present) and Stripe lists Cash App Pay at 2.9% + 30¢ — those are Square/Stripe pages, not cash.app pages.
